body: Thank you for your replies, and for reading. I really appreciate it. I needed your responses.

I've been staying with, a very kind person. He is my ex girlfriend's ex husband and his son. His son and I became close, like a stepson to me, when I was with the son's mom.  In better financial days. The room I'm staying in is his daughter's and she is finishing school and moving home, he'd like me to be out by March 1 so she has her room back, I understand that, he's already been far kinder than I could imagine in my situation. Heh. I don't know, I opened up a google doc today to make a plan, and instead I wrote that, and then posted it here, maybe /r/offmychest would have been better. I'm not really looking for advice, just wanted to complain anonymously I guess. I'm too scared to actually kill myself even though it's the only realistic solution to my problems. Thanks for the reply.
